shared_facts: F-000: On 2026-11-17 the checkout API returned elevated 5xx rates for ~47 minutes.

fact_sheet_lines: payments-api pod restart loop began at 14:02 UTC after a bad config push.
First PagerDuty page fired at 14:04 UTC on the payments-api service.
Rollback of config revision 8821 completed at 14:49 UTC.
Customer-facing error rate on checkout UI rose above 8% starting 14:05 UTC.
Feature flag 'checkout_v2' remained enabled during the incident window.
Support queue first logged a cluster of 'login failed' tickets at 14:07 UTC.
Ticket volume peaked at 62 open incidents before the all-clear at 15:00 UTC.
